paths.name: @google/generative-ai
paths.message: Call Gemini through @neram/ai. It owns the model list, the fallback order, the per-feature Auto/Manual/Off switch and the token metering behind the AI usage panel. Six private copies of this SDK are how the app kept calling models Google had already shut down.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Call Gemini through @neram/ai rather than building the URL by hand, so the call is metered and the budget guard can refuse it.
The design system uses Inter plus one mono stack (siteTokens.fontSans / fontMono in @neram/ui). See apps/marketing/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

No hex colours in sx or style. Use the design-system tokens (import { tokens } from '@/design-system'; server code: siteTokens from '@neram/ui/site-tokens'). Brand colours and the error red: brandColors / errorColor. See apps/marketing/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.
